title: Targeted Optimization - v12b Early Stopping
objective: Implement single optimization technique that achieves ≥1% improvement or ≥2x speedup

optimization_chosen.name: 2-opt Early Stopping with Improvement Threshold
optimization_chosen.mechanism: Stop 2-opt when per-iteration improvement drops below 0.001% threshold
optimization_chosen.rationale: Skips final iterations with minimal returns (22 of 168 iterations) while preserving quality
